, for certain applications, the semantics of a schema can be a useful source of information for discovering meaningful mappings between schemas.

, in many cases, the semantics of a table can provide a useful source of information for discovering schema mappings, especially when the schemas have no or very few local constraints such as keys or referential integrity.
